latestVersion.changelog:
**Artidrop 1.3.5 adds support for publishing multi-file websites and directories.**

- You can now publish entire directories or ZIP files (with index.html) as shareable sites.
- Updated usage docs and examples to reflect multi-file/site publishing.
- Improved instructions on what formats and files are supported.
- No breaking changes for single-file publishing or authentication features.
